title: Marine squadron commander saw the churning white water

tellings.quote: believe, a squadron commander from a a Marine Corps squadron that was actually flying by U. Kurt, I think, is his name.

plain: In 2004, off Southern California, Navy pilots from the carrier USS Nimitz reported a "Tic Tac", a white oval object shaped like the mint, hovering over a patch of churning white water, and the writer Marik von Rennenkampff says a commander of a Marine Corps squadron flying by also saw that water. He gives the commander's name a little unsure ("Kurt, I think, is his name"), passing on an account he did not witness himself. If it holds, the pilots' report would have a further witness from another unit.
